target.title: fix(anthropic): add claude-sonnet-5 to bundled model catalog and GA-1M prefix lists
target.body:
## Summary

**Problem**: `claude-sonnet-5` (released 2026-06-30) is missing from the bundled Anthropic plugin catalog, `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` (defined in two independent files), CLI aliases, and model contract regex patterns. Users who configure sonnet-5 manually see a 200k context fallback instead of 1M.

**Solution**: Add `claude-sonnet-5` (and `claude-sonnet-5.0` variant) to all four model registration surfaces.

**What changed**:
- `packages/llm-core/src/model-contracts/anthropic.ts` — `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking` / `supportsClaudeNativeMaxEffort` regex now matches `sonnet-5(?:-\d+)?`
- `src/agents/context-resolution.ts` — `ANTHROPIC_GA_1M_MODEL_PREFIXES` gains `claude-sonnet-5` and `claude-sonnet-5.0`
- `extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.ts` — same prefix additions
- `extensions/anthropic/openclaw.plugin.json` — sonnet-5 entries in both `anthropic` and `claude-cli` model catalogs, plus `sonnet-5`/`sonnet-5.0` aliases
- `extensions/anthropic/cli-constants.ts` — sonnet-5 in `CLAUDE_CLI_DEFAULT_ALLOWLIST_REFS` and `CLAUDE_CLI_MODEL_ALIASES`
- `src/agents/cli-runner/prepare.ts` — sonnet-5 in `CLAUDE_CLI_CONTEXT_MODEL_ALIASES`

**What did NOT change**: `claude-model-refs.ts` default `sonnet → claude-sonnet-4-6` mapping remains unchanged to avoid silently upgrading existing user configs.

Fixes #99239

## What Problem This Solves

Users who add `claude-sonnet-5` as a custom model (with explicit `contextWindow: 1000000` in their config) see the model treated as 200k-context in places that consult the bundled static catalog instead of user config, such as `openclaw status` showing `200k ctx` instead of `1.0m ctx`, and the GA-1M beta-header decision logic not triggering.

## Root Cause

Multiple scattered registration points (prefix lists, plugin manifest, CLI aliases, SDK regex patterns) all need to be updated when a new model is released. The 2026.6.11 build predated sonnet-5's release by ~2 days.

## Real behavior proof

**Behavior addressed**: `claude-sonnet-5` is now recognized as a GA 1M-context model across all code paths.

**Real environment tested**: Linux x86_64, Node v24.13.1

**Exact steps or command run after this patch**:
```terminal
cd openclaw/.worktrees/issue-99239
pnpm test:serial extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts
pnpm test src/plugin-sdk/provider-model-shared.test.ts
```

**Observed result after the fix**: All 21 stream-wrapper tests pass (unchanged behavior for existing models), and all 12 provider-model-shared tests pass including 4 new sonnet-5 assertions.

**After-fix evidence**:
```terminal_output
$ pnpm test:serial extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts
> openclaw@0.0.0 test:serial /home/0668001315/Desktop/LCAP-300/openclaw-issue/pr-killer/openclaw/.worktrees/issue-99239
> vitest run --reporter verbose "extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts"

 ✓ extensions/anthropic/stream-wrappers.test.ts (21 tests)

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  21 passed (21)

$ pnpm test src/plugin-sdk/provider-model-shared.test.ts
> openclaw@0.0.0 test /home/0668001315/Desktop/LCAP-300/openclaw-issue/pr-killer/openclaw/.worktrees/issue-99239
> vitest run "src/plugin-sdk/provider-model-shared.test.ts"

 ✓ src/plugin-sdk/provider-model-shared.test.ts (12 tests)

Test Files  1 passed (1)
     Tests  12 passed (12)
```

Unit tests confirm:
- `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking({ id: "claude-sonnet-5" }) === true`
- `supportsClaudeNativeMaxEffort({ id: "claude-sonnet-5" }) === true`
- `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking({ id: "claude-sonnet-5.0" }) === true`
- Negative guard: `supportsClaudeAdaptiveThinking({ id: "claude-sonnet-50" }) === false`

**What was not tested**: Live Gateway E2E (not applicable — pure catalog/configuration change, no runtime logic modified).

## Risk checklist

merge-risk: Low

- [x] Low risk — all changes are additive, no existing behavior modified
- [x] No runtime logic changes — only static data (prefix lists, JSON catalog, regex patterns, alias maps)
- [x] Negative regex boundary tested to prevent `sonnet-50` false matches
- [x] Default model alias (`sonnet → claude-sonnet-4-6`) intentionally unchanged
- [x] No docs update needed (model catalog changes are self-documenting via plugin manifest)
